# ColorCode 0.1.0

The first public Android release of ColorCode.

- Create four-color codes from text or small files, then save or share a lossless PNG.
- Read ColorCode images from files or a camera capture, with checksum verification and binary export.
- Read both four-color and five-color ColorCode formats.
- Check for newer releases in the app and download an APK for Android to install with your approval.
- Keep ColorCode Dev installed separately for development testing.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer. ColorCode uses its own format; standard QR readers cannot read these codes. Payloads stay on your device. Internet access is used for update checks and APK downloads.

For future updates, open **ColorCode**, tap **Check for updates**, and approve the download and installation when a newer release is available.
